wylie: gnyis pa la gsum, rang bzhin gyis grub pa mi 'dod pa la kun gzhi sogs khas blang mi dgos par bstan pa dang, las 'gags pa las 'bras bu 'byung ba'i dpe bstan pa dang, de ltar bstan pa la rtsod pa spang ba'o
english: Which brings us to our second point from above: The advantage of showing that the connection between karma and its consequences is eminently correct. Here we proceed in three steps: a demonstration that it is not the case that if we deny that things could exist through any nature of their own, we must then accept things like foundation consciousness; the presentation of a metaphor to illustrate how a karmic consequence can come from the karma itself having stopped; and then finally disproving any debate that may arise about this presentation.
